An '''alacrity implant''' was a type of [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] device that was specifically used to enhance the [[nervous system]] of the being within which it was installed. This resulted in significantly-improved reaction times within the subject, however the invasive nature of the implant required them to be healthier than the norm.<ref name="KOTORII" />

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Within the game, the player character, or any in the party, must have a constitution attribute of 14 or higher in order to equip this device.
